title: Probability of success in every block
statement: Let $t,L$ be natural numbers and let $Q$ be a predicate on natural numbers. For a uniformly random Boolean word of length $tL$, divide the word into $t$ consecutive blocks of length $L$ and interpret each block as a binary integer. The probability that every block's value satisfies $Q$ equals the probability that the value of one uniformly random Boolean word of length $L$ satisfies $Q$, raised to the power $t$.
hypotheses_covered: $Q$ is a predicate on natural numbers
